label: Tauren
text: Walk with patience, traveler. The earth remembers every footstep, and the wind carries stories older than our people.

label: Narrator
text: The old gate creaks open. Beyond it, a forgotten road disappears into the mist, and a single lantern flickers in the dark.

label: Human
text: Good to see you, adventurer. Our scouts spotted trouble near the old watchtower. Gather your supplies, and meet me at the bridge.

label: Undead
text: I used to fear this graveyard, but after spending a few quiet years beneath the soil, I have grown rather fond of the place.

label: Gnome
text: You came at just the right time. I need a brave volunteer to test my new flying machine. You did bring a parachute, right?

label: Troll
text: Stay close, friend. The jungle has many eyes, and not all of them are friendly. Follow my lead, and we will reach the village before nightfall.
